# Guiding Point Consulting
## https://guidingpointconsults.com

Guiding Point Consulting is a certified WBE/MBE digital strategy and web consulting firm based in Tampa, Florida. We partner with public sector prime contractors and mission-driven nonprofits to modernize websites, build AI-supported content systems, and train the humans who run them.

Our belief: technology should bring people closer, not replace the connection between them. AI is getting smarter. We build the systems that keep people at the center of it.

## Services

- Website Audit + Modernization Roadmap: structured review and prioritized action plan for public-facing websites
- AI-Supported Content Operations: SOPs, prompt libraries, workflows, and governance for content teams
- AI Team Training: plain-language, role-specific training for non-technical staff in public sector and nonprofit environments
- Custom Mission-Aware AI Assistants: chatbots trained on an organization's own FAQs, programs, and documents
- Fractional Digital Strategy Lead: ongoing senior digital guidance for organizations that need a strategic partner

## Audiences

- Public sector prime contractors seeking a subcontract delivery partner for digital and AI components
- Nonprofits and mission-driven organizations modernizing their digital presence
